examples.original: [clean] Check common locations like fridge, diningtable, countertop, and sinkbasin first for the object.
examples.control: [clean] Cut lavender back by one-third (late August), never cutting into old, bare wood.

examples.original: [clean] If the object is not found, systematically search through drawers, cabinets, and other storage areas.
examples.control: [clean] Pull weeds while they are still small so they never set seed across the garden.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using the sinkbasin before placing it in the target location.
examples.control: [clean] Keep notes on which varieties thrived so next year's planting plan improves steadily.

examples.original: [clean] Always ensure the target location is accessible and open before placing the object.
examples.control: [clean] Label each row with the variety name and sowing date in permanent ink.
